purpose: retrieve the exact primary paper surfaced by the frozen literature query and determine whether its one-way-arbitrage definition or economics materially reopen the Binance organic-routing family

source.title: A Truckload of Satoshis: Detecting and Measuring One-Way Arbitrage in the Wild
source.endpoint_classification: public unauthenticated arXiv primary-paper PDF retrieval; not a venue endpoint and not state changing

questions: what exact trade path length and linkage define one-way arbitrage
whether profit is cash realized or inferred from public trades and later valuation
which fees latency inventory capital and failed-leg costs are included
whether the evidence isolates recurring executable conditions available prospectively
whether any result materially changes the retained direct one-intermediary or exactly-two-intermediary decisions

decision_boundary.reopen: only a source-proved distinct path or recurrent prospective condition with after-fee economics not already tested may enter a separately frozen current gate
decision_boundary.reject: historical aggregate inferred profit sub-dollar sequences declining economics or missing prospective execution attribution cannot reopen a collector
decision_boundary.promotion: none; the paper cannot accept an edge or grant account order or trading authority

stop_rules: do not retry or follow alternate paper mirrors if this request fails
do not request venue books or histories from this stage
do not treat inferred historical sequences as owned fills or after-all-cost profit
preserve the raw PDF and journal before interpretation
